newsitem.title: USA: Hudson's Grill says CFO resigned in March.
newsitem.headline: Hudson's Grill says CFO resigned in March.

text.p: Hudson's Grill of America Inc said Friday that its chief financial officer, D. Marion Wood, resigned on March 5.
It did not disclose a reason for the resignation, but said that Wood, who has been CFO since 1993, will remain as a director of the company until his term expires on May 27.
The company did not immediately name a successor.

Separately, the company said that its board of directors recommended that shareholders approve the issuance of up to five million shares of preferred stock, to purchase several restaurants as models to show prospective franchisees or as capital for the company.
The company said its annual shareholders meeting will be held on May 27.
